description.de: Den Groß-Shilf in seinem Dungeon besiegen. Dabei dürfen Gegnern keine Aktionspunkte entzogen werden.
description.en: Defeat Silf the Greater Bherb in this boss's dungeon. Characters must not reduce their opponents' AP.
description.es: Vencer a Silf el Rasgabola Mayor en su mazmorra. Los personajes no deben retirar PA a sus adversarios.
description.fr: Vaincre Silf le Rasboul Majeur dans son donjon. Les personnages ne doivent pas retirer de PA aux adversaires.
description.pt: Derrotar Silf, o Rasgabola Maior, em seu calabouço. Os personagens não devem retirar PA dos adversários.
